title.en: An Act Making Appropriation for the Eradication of Disease-Breeding Pests in the Mountain Province.

text.en:
There is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury, not otherwise
appropriated, the sum of ten thousand pesos, or so much thereof as may be necessary, to be expended by the
Bureau of Science for the eradication of disease-breeding pests in the Mountain Province.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, March 16, 1912.
